sections.name: summary
sections.value: Execute u1 first as an independently shippable commit, then u2. Preserve RED output, live-client transcripts, focused/full gate receipts, and the Claude human-veto control; never restart the production daemon.

value.title: Route Omp/Pi through the extension stream
value.success: Omp and Pi bypass both composer gates and select_rung, queue with reason extension-stream, publish message.pushed, and a live OMP receives at turn end.
value.notes: RED first; commit and push u1 alone before starting u2.
value.receipt: RED and GREEN command outputs are summarized in assets/live-proof.md; focused and full delivery tests passed; live sender/target event-stream transcript recorded there.

value.title: Notify senders about queued and late delivery
value.success: One still-queued notice names msg_id, recipient, reason, and attempts after the configured threshold; later delivery emits delivered late and the sender CLI prints outstanding notices.
value.notes: Additive queued-notice control message; default threshold 60 seconds.

value.title: Prove preserved veto and complete delivery
value.success: Claude retains the human-typing veto, all Rust and harness gates pass, cross-model review findings are resolved, and the PR is open.
value.notes: Use a hand-started Claude Opus reviewer; production daemon remains untouched.
